description: This PHP source file defines the class ReviewServiceException in the namespace OrangeHRM\Performance\Exception. It extends the base Exception class and provides static factory methods to create specific exception instances related to performance review operations in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ReviewServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling errors related to performance review services in OrangeHRM. It provides static methods to generate specific exception messages.

methods.name: activateWithoutJobTitle
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that a review cannot be activated for employees without a Job Title with KPI.

methods.name: activateWithoutKPI
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that a review cannot be activated without KPIs.

methods.name: pastEmployeeForReviewer
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that a past employee cannot be assigned as a reviewer.

methods.name: invalidSupervisor
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the selected supervisor for reviewer is invalid.
